newsitem.title: USA: Atlas evaluating Gold Bar options.
newsitem.headline: Atlas evaluating Gold Bar options.

text.p: Atlas Corp said it is evaluating options for its Gold Bar claim block near Eureka, Nev., including outright sale of the property.

Last week the company said it and Vista Gold Corp agreed to terminate their joint venture arrangement, which covered a portion of the claim. As a result Atlas has regained a 100 percent interest in this portion of the claim block, which contains the recently identified Mill Site deposit and the company's Gold Bar Mill, a 3,000 ton per day carbon-in-leach facility.
A joint venture agreement with Rayrock Yellowknife Resources Inc covering about 30 percent of the claim remains in effect.
"The Gold Bar project contains exceptional exploration potential and Atlas is evaluating various options including an outright sale," the company said.

"The Gold Bar claim block encompasses nearly 100 square miles on the prolific Battle Mountain Trend and remains under-explored. Several companies have advanced proposals over the last three years to acquire Gold Bar, and interest in the property continues to be high," it added.
